card.name: Overdose section management wording
card.fires_on: Words inside overdose-section sentences, such as "no" in "There is no specific antidote", "overdose" after "an" or "acute", and "supportive" or "treatment" in supportive-care statements.

modes.label: No specific antidote
modes.description: The word "no" or "overdose" in statements that no specific antidote or treatment exists.
modes.example: 10 OVERDOSAGE No experience with overdose is available. There is<< no>> specific antidote for overdose with ALEC

modes.label: Supportive care wording
modes.description: Words like "supportive", "treatment" or "cases" in instructions on general supportive measures after overdose.
modes.example: If overdose occurs, the patient should be monitored, and standard supportive<< treatment>> applied as required.

card.plain: It lights up in the overdose section when the label says there is no specific antidote and supportive care should be given.
